sayWindow: 💧 Rosa eyes the cistern — full to the brim. No sense hauling water there's no room for; they turn to the wood run instead.
🪵 Rosa hauls back 6 wood. The pile grows. (32 logs now.)
🪨 Isabella pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (3 stone now.)
🍂 Amara gathers deadfall — 1 stick. The pile grows. (1 sticks now.)
💧 Isabella returns with water: +2 clean.
🚶 Amara is back — found Salim.
💧 Yuki returns with water: +4 clean.
📨 Word came: a tired nurse wants to join Haven. "I can work. That's all I'm selling." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
📓 Journal: a tired nurse applied remotely.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1110 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Nino came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)

Yuki has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Rosa passes around Muscadine Grapes. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.

David spends the afternoon with the tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Hickory Nuts — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Hickory Nuts. Hickory nut. Hard shell, sweet meat. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 The tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — THAT's what David was describing. Hickory Nuts. It clicks like a key turning.
Ella was watching. Now they know Hickory Nuts too.
Rafael came back with 710 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 355 kcal in, 355 kcal eaten at the fire.
Ella and Isabella lingered over the fire together.
David and Amara lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Ava looks at the full shelves and waves off the day's share. "No more into the store — we eat at the fire, and the shelves keep."
📓 Journal: Ella taught Nino Herbal Medicine.
— DAY 5 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, 2 unknown nuts went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Hickory Nuts — named and noted.
Ella Koehler reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
MOLT: your skin splits. You step out new, whole — and naked. All equipped gear lost in the old skin. (Once per week.)
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND Molt. It resonates with: something unnamed.
(−100 kcal — food becomes molt.)
